notablePrerequisites:
Sinking Feeling attached to Kibo.
Kibo does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kibo's original ability by tapping them, causing each player to create a Banana artifact token.
Activate your Banana by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R/G} and gaining 2 life.
Martyr's Bond triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice an artifact they control and/or activate their own Banana in response.
Kibo triggers for each artifact an opponent controls that was put into a graveyard, putting a +1/+1 counter onto each Ape or Monkey you control that many times.
Activate Kibo using the ability granted by Sinking Feeling by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on Kibo, untapping them.
Repeat any number of times.
Activate Screaming Shield's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to Kibo.
Activate Kibo using the ability granted by Screaming Shield by paying {2} and tapping them, causing target player to mill three cards.
Activate Kibo using the ability granted by Sinking Feeling by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on Kibo, untapping them.
Repeat the previous two steps any number of times.
